abilitySays.line: The System notes the synergy — foraged a plant new to this ground: +1 field XP.
🎁 "We watched your first week! You're good at... let us see..." (A gift awaits — choose an ability.)
⬢ SYSTEM: "Neural depth 20. I can hold more of you now — ability slots: 2."
🎁 "OH! You can hold more now! We've been HOLDING this — take it, take it, take it!" (The System's gift awaits — choose an ability.)

◈ THE SPARK — something clicks. A trick Vanessa learned long ago suddenly has edges it never had. SYSTEM: "ANOMALY: organic unit demonstrates pattern recognition. Slot capacity increased. We are taking notes." (Ability slots: 2)
✨ Ability gained: Survivor (L1). You endured. +10 max health.
✨ Ability gained: Echo Location (L1). Clap once: you sense the shape of the land — reveals the 3x3 world-map tiles around you. 1/day.

🚨 Highbeam Deer, Hushpuppy, Drum-Belly, Drum-Belly is at Haven's door. The village looks to you. Four ways to call: a RUNNER (slow, dangerous), a SIGNAL FIRE (fast, loud, everyone sees), the SYSTEM RELAY (if it can carry voices), or an ABILITY CRY (if your build has one). Each with honest costs.
💛 The Carpenter's square is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — resolve: trauma lands a quarter lighter, while worn.)
💛 The Knife roll is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — quiet luck: 1 in 5 misses lands anyway, while worn.)
💛 The Photo Album is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — quiet luck: 1 in 5 misses lands anyway, while worn.)
💛 The Home key is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — anchor: chasers tire faster when you flee, while worn.)
What Vanessa kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
SYSTEM: "INTRUDER REPELLED. The pantry’s aroma is now classified as a defensive liability. The audience is chanting the defenders’ names. Fan clubs are forming. This is how it starts."
⬢ SYSTEM: "Neural depth 35. I can hold more of you now — ability slots: 3."
◈ THE MENTOR — Adaeze watches Patricia work, then reaches over. "No. Like this." An hour later something has unlocked that no manual could teach. (Ability slots: 3)
◈ AUDIENCE TRIAL — SYSTEM: "The audience wants an encore. A trial, then — smaller this time, but televised." Haul 3,000 kcal to the pantry within 3 days. Reward: integration, and a lesson.

◈ ARC III — ENGINES. SYSTEM: "VIEWERSHIP MILESTONE. Organic unit demonstrates compounding capability. Resonance protocols unlocked." — Your gifts deepen. Used in sequence, they resonate. The village is no longer just surviving. It is becoming something.
⬢ SYSTEM: "Neural depth 50. I can hold more of you now — ability slots: 4."

Aria leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about Performance Review. Dodge unpredictably. It grades your dodges aloud — so stop giving it the same dodge twice. Move two rounds running, never the same way, and its lock breaks. Unpredictability is the only passing grade."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Performance Review: Dodge unpredictably. It grades your dodges aloud — so stop giving it the same dodge twice. Move two rounds running, never the same way, and its lock breaks. Unpredictability is the only passing grade. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

📓 Codex: Counter: Dodge unpredictably — It grades your dodges aloud — so stop giving it the same dodge twice. Move two rounds running, never the same way, and its lock breaks. Unpredictability is the only passing grade.
◈ THE TRIAL — the audience is restless. The System offers Patricia a trial, broadcast live. Survive it and take the slot. Refuse it and... well. The audience remembers refusals. (Ability slots: 4)

◈ RESONANCE HARMONICS — SYSTEM: "HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED. Objects with high observer-attention waveforms function as auxiliary capacitors. We call this RESONANCE HARMONICS. We do not know why the waveforms taste like grief. We have stopped asking." — Hold a keepsake. Think about them. The System will do the math. (It is not math. It is love. The System will never know.) Channel keepsakes from your pack.
⬢ SYSTEM: "Neural depth 65. I can hold more of you now — ability slots: 5."
✦ Blathnaid has found something — Tells. Days of lie_detector and open_book side by side, and now they move as one. (tells: villager synergy discovered)
✦ Blathnaid has found something — Airtight. Days of lie_detector and evidence_board side by side, and now they move as one. (airtight: villager synergy discovered)
✦ Adaeze has found something — Peacemaker's Voice. Days of diplomat and mediator side by side, and now they move as one. (peacemakers_voice: villager synergy discovered)

◈ THE CREEP — Patricia's thoughts have an echo now. The System's echo. Or theirs. Hard to tell anymore. Gifts used in sequence resonate — try them together. (Ability slots: 5)
⬢ SYSTEM: "Neural depth 93. I can hold more of you now — ability slots: 6."
◈ THE GRANT — full integration. The System opens the last slot like a door it built just for Patricia. "You have been adequate entertainment. We upgrade adequate." (Ability slots: 6)
◈ TRIAL COMPLETE — the audience applauds, which sounds like static. (+15 integration, gift: a lesson: Tireless Stride)
✦ Aroha has found something — Peacemaker's Voice. Days of diplomat and mediator side by side, and now they move as one. (peacemakers_voice: villager synergy discovered)
✦ Aroha has found something — Word of Mouth. Days of gossip_network and peacemaker side by side, and now they move as one. (word_of_mouth: villager synergy discovered)
✨ Ability gained: Water Breathing (L1). You can breathe underwater. Gills, magic, or just really good lungs — the System doesn't explain.
⬆️ Beast-calm deepened to L2! Your calm is contagious.
💛 You hold Coat button and practice — one gift, deeply. They would want you to get better at this. (+6 experience to Beast-calm)

🚨 The Loud Beast, The Loud Beast, The Mountain Lord, Judge Hoot is at Haven's door. The village looks to you. Four ways to call: a RUNNER (slow, dangerous), a SIGNAL FIRE (fast, loud, everyone sees), the SYSTEM RELAY (if it can carry voices), or an ABILITY CRY (if your build has one). Each with honest costs.
◈ TRIAL RECOGNIZED — the System has been watching. You WON a fight. Not survived — won. The audience is still standing. So are you. (Combat track +)
⬆️ Water Breathing deepened to L2! The deep is shallow.
💛 You hold Carpenter's square and practice — one gift, deeply. They would want you to get better at this. (+6 experience to Water Breathing)

✨ Ability gained: Pocket Sand (L1). Throw sand in eyes. Blinds for 2 rounds. (You always have sand. Don't ask where.)
✦ Liam has found something — Apex Sense. Days of tracker and echo_location side by side, and now they move as one. (apex_sense: villager synergy discovered)
⬆️ Pocket Sand deepened to L2! You always have sand. Don't ask.
💛 You hold Coat button and practice — one gift, deeply. They would want you to get better at this. (+6 experience to Pocket Sand)
🌀 Water Breathing is STRAINING at its edges. The gift wants to become something — and it wants YOU to choose what.
(Evolution awaits — choose one. Your power becomes something new.)

📺 SYSTEM CHALLENGE: "We have designed a trial JUST for you. Based on our observations. Which are extensive. And flattering."
1. Trial of the Long Stalk — Take game with patience, not noise.
2. Trial of Stone — Endure. That is the whole trial. Endure.
3. Trial of Tongues — Talk the village through something hard.
Each trial takes a FULL day-part and leaves you drained (−250 kcal). Pick one. The System waits — it has already run the simulations, and it is terrible at keeping secrets.
✦ Leo has found something — Apex Sense. Days of tracker and echo_location side by side, and now they move as one. (apex_sense: villager synergy discovered)

Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. (The next feast grants FEASTED until tomorrow's dawn: strikes & abilities uplifted, devotion ×1.5 — richer feasts hit harder.)
